scope: Qualification-only protect-from-close flag on the original runner query token immediately before its original checked CloseHandle once; no unprotect, duplicate, alternate close or retry. Original ownership, first failure and deadline rules stay intact.
required_evidence: Fresh disconnected VM042 passes original pristine readiness.
Four cold byte-bound roles; no setup, token, default-DACL or late-create fault marker.
Original setup and actual process/thread creation and security readback complete.
V6 bounded contiguous same-owner trace; exactly one original create, protection, close and first failure.
Protection succeeds and is read back before close; same original query token changes Held to CloseFailed(nonzero code).
Original first failure is TokenSecurity/RunnerTokenClose with same native code; process/thread and login/restricted/launch handles stay Held.
Original observation debt and Unknown remain; no post-failure native requery, retry, transfer or cleanup receipt.
Original journal/controller prefix, binding and first-failure delivery agree.
Same policy owner restores only actually added privilege and closes own policy resources.
Independent diagnostic takes one fixed quiet interval and one read of five public files, then closes own transport.
failure_rule: Missing or contradictory evidence leaves the gate open; diagnostics create no cleanup or replay authority.
diagnostic_coverage_exclusions: No trace promised before command retention or after append failure; absence proves nothing.
